mapper.select: SELECT CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) FROM DUAL
SELECT PARK_ID,ACCESS_TYPE,INSTANCE_ID,DIRECT_TAKEOVER_VERSION FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_ROUTE WHERE ACCESS_TYPE=#{access} AND PARK_ID IN #{park}
SELECT INSTANCE_ID FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_ROUTE WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND ACCESS_TYPE=#{access}
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_STATE WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_JOB WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{id} AND LANE=#{lane} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_JOB SET LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken,jdbcType=VARCHAR},LEASE_UNTIL=#{leaseUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},LAST_ADVANCED_AT=#{lastAdvancedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},DEVICE_CURSOR=#{deviceCursor,jdbcType=VARCHAR},NUMBER_CURSOR=#{numberCursor,jdbcType=NUMERIC},TEXT_CURSOR=#{textCursor,jdbcType=VARCHAR},PARK_INDEX=#{parkIndex},FAILURES=#{failures} WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{instanceId} AND LANE=#{lane}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN b.ACTION='DELETE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE c WHERE c.TARGET_ID=t.ID AND c.SOURCE_ACTION='DELETE') THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'ADD' END
mapper.select: SELECT ID,PARK_ID,DEVICE_ID,OPERATION_QUEUE,FAIR_KEY FROM ( SELECT fair.* FROM (SELECT q.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PARK_ID ORDER BY DEVICE_RANK, CASE WHEN #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR FAIR_KEY > #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,FAIR_KEY,ID) PARK_RANK FROM ( SELECT t.ID,t.PARK_ID,t.DEVICE_ID,t.OPERATION_QUEUE, LPAD(TO_CHAR(t.PARK_ID),10,'0')||':'||t.DEVICE_ID FAIR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY t.PARK_ID,t.DEVICE_ID ORDER BY t.ID) DEVICE_RANK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET a WHERE a.PARK_ID=t.PARK_ID AND a.DEVICE_ID=t.DEVICE_ID AND a.ACCESS_TYPE=t.ACCESS_TYPE AND a.STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING')) DEVICE_ACTIVE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET a JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH ab ON ab.ID=a.BATCH_ID WHERE a.PARK_ID=t.PARK_ID AND a.DEVICE_ID=t.DEVICE_ID AND a.ACCESS_TYPE=t.ACCESS_TYPE AND a.STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING') AND CASE WHEN ab.ACTION='DELETE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE ac WHERE ac.TARGET_ID=a.ID AND ac.SOURCE_ACTION='DELETE') THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'ADD' END=#{priority}) DEVICE_SAME FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH b ON b.ID=t.BATCH_ID WHERE AND t.DEVICE_ID=#{p.selectedDevice} AND t.STATE='QUEUED' AND ()=#{priority} AND (t.NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT IS NULL OR t.NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT <=#{now}) AND (t.LEASE_UNTIL IS NULL OR t.LEASE_UNTIL <#{now}) AND COALESCE((SELECT USED FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_QUOTA r WHERE r.INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND r.PARK_ID=t.PARK_ID AND r.DEVICE_ID=t.DEVICE_ID AND r.SCOPE_TYPE='DEVICE' AND r.LANE=#{priority} AND r.WINDOW_KEY=TO_CHAR(#{now},'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')),0) +CASE WHEN t.ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END <= FLOOR(#{p.deviceHttpPerSecond}*3/8) ) q WHERE DEVICE_RANK <= LEAST(#{p.perDeviceInflight}-DEVICE_ACTIVE,#{p.perDeviceInflight}-DEVICE_SAME- #{p.perDeviceDeleteInflight}#{p.perDeviceAddInflight})) fair ORDER BY PARK_RANK,CASE WHEN #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR FAIR_KEY > #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,FAIR_KEY,ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <=#{limit}

SELECT PARK_ID,PRIORITY,STATE,COUNT(*) TARGET_COUNT FROM ( SELECT t.PARK_ID,() PRIORITY,t.STATE FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH b ON b.ID=t.BATCH_ID WHERE AND ) GROUP BY PARK_ID,PRIORITY,STATE

SELECT CASE WHEN WINDOW_KEY=#{window} THEN USED ELSE 0 END FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_QUOTA WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND PARK_ID=#{park} AND DEVICE_ID=#{device} AND SCOPE_TYPE=#{kind} AND LANE=#{lane}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_QUOTA q USING(SELECT #{instance} INSTANCE_ID,#{park} PARK_ID,#{device} DEVICE_ID,#{kind} SCOPE_TYPE,#{lane} LANE FROM DUAL) k ON(q.INSTANCE_ID=k.INSTANCE_ID AND q.PARK_ID=k.PARK_ID AND q.DEVICE_ID=k.DEVICE_ID AND q.SCOPE_TYPE=k.SCOPE_TYPE AND q.LANE=k.LANE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET WINDOW_KEY=#{window},USED=#{used} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(INSTANCE_ID,PARK_ID,DEVICE_ID,SCOPE_TYPE,LANE,WINDOW_KEY,USED) VALUES(k.INSTANCE_ID,k.PARK_ID,k.DEVICE_ID,k.SCOPE_TYPE,k.LANE,#{window},#{used})
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM (SELECT ph.ID,seed.STATE SEED_STATE FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE ph JOIN SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE seed ON seed.ID=#{id} JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t ON t.ID=ph.TARGET_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH b ON b.ID=t.BATCH_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET st ON st.ID=seed.TARGET_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH sb ON sb.ID=st.BATCH_ID WHERE ph.INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND ph.PARK_ID IN AND ph.PARK_ID=seed.PARK_ID AND ph.ACCESS_TYPE=seed.ACCESS_TYPE AND ph.DEVICE_ID=seed.DEVICE_ID AND ph.PHASE=seed.PHASE AND ph.STATE=seed.STATE AND (seed.STATE='ACCEPTED' OR ()=CASE WHEN sb.ACTION='DELETE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE sc WHERE sc.TARGET_ID=st.ID AND sc.SOURCE_ACTION='DELETE') THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'ADD' END) AND ph.ACTION=seed.ACTION AND ph.RESOURCE_TYPE=seed.RESOURCE_TYPE AND ph.SERVICE_TYPE=seed.SERVICE_TYPE AND DECODE(ph.CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL,seed.CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL,1,0)=1 AND DECODE(ph.CHANNEL_NO,seed.CHANNEL_NO,1,0)=1 AND DECODE(ph.START_TIME,seed.START_TIME,1,0)=1 AND DECODE(ph.OVER_TIME,seed.OVER_TIME,1,0)=1 AND (seed.STATE='PREPARED' OR ph.REQUEST_KEY=seed.REQUEST_KEY) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ph.ID=seed.ID THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,ph.ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=CASE WHEN SEED_STATE='ACCEPTED' THEN 200 ELSE #{limit} END

SELECT PRIORITY,STATE,COUNT(*) TARGET_COUNT,MIN(ACCEPTED_AT) OLDEST_AT FROM ( SELECT () PRIORITY,t.STATE,t.ACCEPTED_AT FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH b ON b.ID=t.BATCH_ID WHERE ) GROUP BY PRIORITY,STATE
SELECT STATE FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET WHERE ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT a SET STATUS='EXPIRED',UPDATE_TIME=#{now} WHERE a.TARGET_ID=#{id} AND a.STATUS='CLAIMED' AND a.EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL AND a.EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t WHERE t.ID=a.TARGET_ID AND t.STATE='EXECUTING' AND t.LEASE_TOKEN=a.LEASE_TOKEN AND t.LEASE_UNTIL <=#{now}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE p WHERE p.ATTEMPT_ID=a.ID)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.* FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE c JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD s ON s.ID=c.SOURCE_COORD_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_RESOURCE_COORD r ON r.ID=c.RESOURCE_COORD_ID WHERE s.PARK_ID IN AND r.ACCESS_TYPE=#{p.accessType} AND c.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND c.SOURCE_GENERATION=s.GENERATION AND ((c.RESOURCE_GENERATION <r.GENERATION AND c.TARGET_ID IS NOT NULL) OR (c.TARGET_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE h WHERE h.SOURCE_COORD_ID=c.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND h.SOURCE_GENERATION=c.SOURCE_GENERATION AND h.RESOURCE_COORD_ID=c.RESOURCE_COORD_ID AND h.BINDING_REVISION>0))) AND c.ID>#{after} ORDER BY c.ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=#{limit}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.* FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE c JOIN SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD s ON s.ID=c.SOURCE_COORD_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_RESOURCE_COORD r ON r.ID=c.RESOURCE_COORD_ID WHERE s.PARK_ID IN AND r.ACCESS_TYPE=#{p.accessType} AND s.SOURCE_KIND='STAFF_AUTH' AND c.SOURCE_GENERATION=s.GENERATION AND c.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND c.STATE='CONVERGED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE pending WHERE pending.SOURCE_COORD_ID=c.SOURCE_COORD_ID AND pending.SOURCE_GENERATION=c.SOURCE_GENERATION AND pending.BINDING_REVISION=0 AND pending.STATE!='CONVERGED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST d WHERE d.ID=c.REQUEST_ID AND d.STATUS!='CONVERGED') AND c.ID>#{after} ORDER BY c.ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=#{limit}

SELECT ID FROM (SELECT t.ID FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET t WHERE AND t.STATE NOT IN ('CONVERGED','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE c JOIN SMT_AUTH_DELETE_REQUEST d ON d.ID=c.REQUEST_ID WHERE c.TARGET_ID=t.ID AND d.STATUS!='CONVERGED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE c WHERE c.TARGET_ID=t.ID) AND t.ID>#{after} ORDER BY t.ID) WHERE ROWNUM<=#{limit}
